How terrible it will be for people who cheat when they measure.
When they take from people, they take the full amount.
But when they measure or weigh for others, they give less.
Do they not think they will be raised up again?
For a very big Day.
The Day when people stand before the Lord of all.
No! The book of the bad people is in Sijjin, a low place.
What can make you know what Sijjin is?
It is a book that is written.
How terrible it will be that Day for people who said no.
Those who say no to the Day of Judgment.
No one says no to it except a sinful person who goes too far.
When Our verses are read to him he says: These are just old stories!
No! Their hearts are covered with rust from the bad things they kept doing.
No! On that Day they will be kept away from their Lord.
Then they will go into Hell and burn.
Then they will be told: This is what you said was not true.
No! The book of the good people is in Illiyyin, a high place.
What can make you know what Illiyyin is?
It is a book that is written.
Those who are close to Allah see it.
The good people will be happy and have joy.
They will sit on couches and look around.
You will see the joy shining on their faces.
They will be given a pure drink that is sealed.
It ends with the smell of musk, a very good smell. So for this, let people who want to race, race.
It is mixed with a drink called Tasnim.
It is a spring. People who are close to Allah drink from it.
The bad people used to laugh at the believers.
When the believers walked by, they would wink at each other to make fun of them.
And when they went home, they went home joking.
And when they saw the believers they said: These people are really lost!
But they were not sent to watch over the believers.
So today the believers are laughing at the people who said no.
They are on couches, looking.
Were the people who said no paid back for what they used to do?
